set.body: Next BIDS slice after the initial module epic. Add typed scan selectors and metadata accessors over BidsProject without coupling shared BIDS code to dataset/image/design. Scope: func/preproc/anat scan selectors, sidecar metadata records, repetition-time inference from inherited metadata, and richer manifest summaries where useful. Acceptance: shared tests cover selectors and summaries over synthetic manifests; JVM fixture tests cover sidecar-derived TR/metadata; sbt bidsJVM/test bidsJS/test and sbt compileAll testAll pass.
set.title: BIDS scan and metadata accessors
